Bihar men 13 navanbar ko mausam kaisa rahne vala hai? kya pradesh men barish hogi ya subah ke samay kohre ka asar dekhne ko milega? mausam vibhag (IMD) ne bihar ke mausam ko lekar naya purvanuman jari kiya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
